title: Cancellation Terms of a Confirmed Hotel Reservation
content:
Only the guest may cancel their own confirmed reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range, and the cancellation is confirmed by the guest rather than performed on their behalf. The guest states in this conversation which of the rooms on the reservation they are giving up; that statement is the guest's own and is taken as it is given, against the reservation named.

**The free-cancellation term.** A cancellation is handled free of penalty only when frozen time is not after the moment the guest's reservation was confirmed by the property plus the free-cancellation term of the rate plan booked. The clock runs from the confirmation moment recorded on the reservation. The free-cancellation term is counted in whole elapsed hours from the confirmation moment, never mixing elapsed hours with calendar days, and a cancellation confirmed exactly at the boundary is still free. The number of hours is the figure contracted against the plan booked.

*Boundary cases, hypothetical hours.* Take a plan whose free-cancellation term is 24 hours. A cancellation confirmed 23 whole elapsed hours after the confirmation moment is inside the term and free; one confirmed exactly at 24 whole elapsed hours is at the boundary and still free; one confirmed 25 whole elapsed hours after it is outside the term and penalised.

**Inside and outside the term.** Inside the free-cancellation term nothing is withheld on any rate plan, and the deposit or prepayment is returned in full. Outside it the penalty is read off the rate plan's cancellation ladder by how many whole days lie between the cancellation and the arrival date; where the ladder is silent the plan's flat share of the room total applies, and where the plan expresses its penalty in room nights those nights are taken at the booked rate. A plan that returns nothing withholds the whole room total and returns only the taxes the property itself does not keep.

**Part of a reservation.** A cancellation of some but not all rooms is penalised room by room on the rooms given up, and the remaining rooms keep their original terms.

**The agency's own charge.** The agency service fee is not returned on cancellation, because the booking service it pays for has already been performed.
